mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, which typically precede higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when INDPRO and HOUST both decline, with SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and above 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650.0 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.1%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0.
